theorems.name: Submission.dimred_cs_st_closedBall_measure_scaling
theorems.statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (μ : Measure (Euclid P)) (L : Submodule ℝ (Euclid P)), (∀ y ∈ L, ∀ A : Set (Euclid P), MeasurableSet A → μ ((fun x => y + x) ⁻¹' A) = μ A) → (∀ lam : ℝ, 0 < lam → ∀ A : Set (Euclid P), MeasurableSet A → μ ((fun x => lam • x) '' A) = ENNReal.ofReal (lam ^ n) * μ A) → ∀ z ∈ L, ∀ ρ : ℝ, 0 < ρ → μ (closedBall z ρ) = ENNReal.ofReal (ρ ^ n) * μ (closedBall z 1)
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
